ownership.quote: Scaleway, filiale intégralement détenue par Iliad, est intégrée dans les états financiers consolidés du groupe

stage.note: Scaleway (formerly Online.net/Online SAS) has been wholly owned by Iliad (Xavier Niel's telecom group) since Iliad's 2002 acquisition of Online; it has no independent priced funding rounds of its own — it is funded and consolidated as part of Iliad group accounts.

last_round.quote: Le rapport financier 2024 du groupe Iliad, maison mère de Scaleway, ne fournit aucune donnée détaillée sur les résultats de la filiale

revenue.basis: French Wikipedia infobox figure (103.2 M€ for FY2022, +37% y/y reported for 2024 without exact amount, and ~100 M€ claimed for 2024 by Journal du Net); EUR converted to USD at approx. 1.08 USD/EUR. Iliad does not publish Scaleway's standalone accounts, so this is a third-party/press estimate, not a confirmed company filing.
revenue.quote: chiffre d'affaires: 103,2 M€ (2022); En 2024, Scaleway revendiquait environ cent millions d'euros de chiffre d'affaires, contre près d'un milliard pour OVHcloud.

note: Scaleway (ex Online.net / Online SAS, founded 1999) has been a wholly-owned subsidiary of French telecom group Iliad (founded/controlled by Xavier Niel) since Iliad acquired Online in 2002; it is not an independently funded startup and has no VC rounds or accelerator history. Iliad does not publish Scaleway's standalone financial statements (consolidated into group accounts), so revenue and profitability figures come from press estimates/leaks rather than confirmed company filings; French Wikipedia's infobox (sourced to Belgian/French business registries) cites €103.2M revenue and a net loss of €8.83M for FY2022, with Journal du Net reporting ~€100M revenue for 2024 and Iliad's 2024 annual report citing +37% y/y growth for the Scaleway segment without an exact figure.
